about: Where a dialogue stops for the player, each ended by a bg3_wait started before it, at GK.Speed ${SPEED}: the dialogue opens (its first
line is spoken: nothing to answer yet), the first choice shows its answers (dialogue_choice, with the game's tags), and answer 1 - a
Persuasion check, d20 + modifier against the DC - opens the roll window.
Run: gatekit --instance <copy> mcp sequence tests/_selftest/attention/dialogue_phases.json --set SPEED=1  (and 10) in GustavX:Basic_Level_A.

arguments.expression: (function() local b = GK.Gui.Blocking() if not b.window then return true end GK.Gui.Resolve({ roll = 'throw', dialogue = 'last', reaction = 'decline', box = 'affirmative' }) return false end)()

arguments.code: GK.Fixture.Clear() GK.Speed.Set(${SPEED}) GK.FixtureT = GK.Fixture.Talker{ dialog = 'roll' } return GK.Speed.Get()
local p = GK.Gui.DialoguePhase() return p and { phase = p.phase, answers = p.answers }
